TARGET_DSTRUCT_K2_K3.role: ordinary Manual forward classification; K2 coarse, K3 main
TARGET_DSTRUCT_K2_K3.training: ordinary Manual, primary and admitted other targets
domains: hard structure and hard minus easy structure
TARGET_DSTRUCT_K2_K3.gates: all>=12 images/3 buildings; easy>=5/2; hard>=4/2; complete required features
TARGET_DSTRUCT_K2_K3.embedding: robust median/(p85-p15), std then1 fallback, clip ±3, PCA <=2/domain, equal-domain RMS normalization; Ward one tree

RFUSE_GEOM_K2.training: actual ordinary Manual natural teams, n10–24, legal targets, complete model outputs, at least four unique teams within pool×n
RFUSE_GEOM_K2.indirect_quality_dependence: shared training eligibility requires all geometry and quality outputs; Q coefficients are saved for description but do not enter GEOM embedding or alpha selection
RFUSE_GEOM_K2.regression: occurrence-weighted centered team composition shares and outputs within pool×n; buildings equal, images equal, available pool×n groups equal within image; ridge coefficients
RFUSE_GEOM_K2.alpha_selection: minimum inner-building normalized geometry response MSE, domain/stratum balanced; outer building excluded
RFUSE_GEOM_K2.embedding: robust median/(p85-p15), clip ±3, PCA2/domain, equal-domain RMS normalization; Ward
RFUSE_GEOM_K2.semi_use: cross-mode application of Manual response labels, not a separately trained Semi classifier
RFUSE_GEOM_K2.distinct_methods: GEOMQ includes Q; TARGET_RFUSE changes target weighting; neither silently substitutes for RFUSE_GEOM_K2

OPPJOINT_K3_K4.role: joint original-answer, quality/time and mixture profile
OPPJOINT_K3_K4.training: ordinary Manual, legal primary and admitted other targets; not Manual+Semi joint training
domains: Q overall, weighted p20 and opportunity response
source-centered logT overall and opportunity response
OPPJOINT_K3_K4.gates: all>=12 images/3 buildings; opportunity variance>1e-5, >=2 levels; positive time>=12 images/3 buildings and estimable response
OPPJOINT_K3_K4.embedding: robust median/(p85-p15), clip ±3, PCA<=2/domain, equal-domain RMS normalization; Ward one tree
OPPJOINT_K3_K4.difficulty: formal picture difficulty is not a JOINT clustering input; current label reuse verified numerically
OPPJOINT_K3_K4.warning: C1...Ck are per-fold training Q-center ranks. ALL role names and K3/K4 splits are not fixed identities across folds

analysis.LOBO: join worker_id and target building to heldout_building
analysis.unit: object then worker-target; class means within the same legal target; target differences equally within image; images equally within building; report both image- and building-equal summaries
analysis.time: positive source_active_time_seconds only, comparisons stratified by origin/time_source; other-target time denotes original task record and is not space-specific labor
analysis.scope: ordinary Manual primary main; other targets separate; Semi cross-mode separate; no doorway or special-range expansion
analysis.missing: unscored or unknown-class results remain missing, never zero; metric-specific finite support
